The '''AirPatrol II''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] manufactured by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]]. They were used by [[Lant Mining Corporation]]'s [[Security Patrol]] to enforce the law on LMC-controlled [[Planet/Legends|planets]].
